crossRefs.note: Do you see a man wise in his own eyes? There is more hope for a fool than for him.
Don’t be hasty to go out of his presence. Don’t persist in an evil thing, for he does whatever pleases him,
Even a fool, when he keeps silent, is counted wise. When he shuts his lips, he is thought to be discerning.
Look at me, and be astonished. Lay your hand on your mouth.
“Behold, I am of small account. What will I answer you? I lay my hand on my mouth.
for the king’s word is supreme. Who can say to him, “What are you doing?”
The nations will see and be ashamed of all their might. They will lay their hand on their mouth. Their ears will be…
They will lick the dust like a serpent. Like crawling things of the earth they shall come trembling out of their dens.…
Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be…

translations.web: “If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.
translations.bsb: If you have foolishly exalted yourself or if you have plotted evil, put your hand over your mouth.
translations.kjv: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, or if thou hast thought evil, lay thine hand upon thy mouth.
translations.asv: If thou hast done foolishly in lifting up thyself, Or if thou hast thought evil, Lay thy hand upon thy mouth.
